name: Biotin
description: A B vitamin, sold in dietary supplements including hair, skin and nail products

note.text: In the best study, double-blind and placebo-controlled, hair growth did not differ between biotin and placebo.

bullets: Biotin is a **B vitamin** taken by mouth in supplements
**In people,** a mechanism for hair loss is not established
**Lab tests:** biotin can interfere with some blood tests, including troponin
Best study: no difference vs placebo
10-man crossover study in men without hair loss

regulatory.text: Dietary supplement; not approved for hair loss
Warns biotin can cause wrong lab test results

references: Yelich et al., J Clin Aesthet Dermatol, oral biotin for hair (review), Aug 2024
FDA, Biotin interference with troponin lab tests, Jun 2022
